name: react-select with shadcn/ui
summary: Gist of a react-select wrapper restyled with shadcn/ui class names, plus custom option and indicator components.
description: A GitHub Gist showing how to use react-select with shadcn/ui: a SimpleSelect forwardRef wraps react-select unstyled and applies a classNames and styles configuration built from Tailwind classes that mirror shadcn form fields, with a createClassNames factory and custom Option, ClearIndicator, DropdownIndicator and MultiValueRemove components.
contains: class names and styles aligned with shadcn/ui form styling
custom Option, ClearIndicator, DropdownIndicator and MultiValueRemove components
